page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Top: a small handwritten number (left out). Title lines in large capitals, then a block of italic lines, a printer's line, a woodcut device, and the place and date at the foot. A dark ink blot covers two lines in the middle.
page.notes: The small number at the top right ("93823") looks like a handwritten shelf or catalogue mark, so I left it out. The title page is mirrored by show-through from the reverse, which makes several lines hard to read. "PHYSIOGNO-" and "MONICA IE-" are read from partly mirrored letters, and the first title line in particular is uncertain. The italic lines (Variis expeditis, Dictionibus, Characteribus, Epigrammatibus) are read from show-through and may differ slightly. The name "WANGEN" is doubtful. An engraved woodcut device (printer's mark) sits between the name and the place line, so I described it here and did not transcribe it. The ink blot covers the two lines beside it, so those words cannot be recovered. The date "cIↄ Iↄ cx" is read as MDCX.
